surfaces.description: rustfmt check over the engine crate (pinned toolchain)
Clippy with -D warnings over all targets, CPU default features

Full default-feature host suite: lib target plus every integration target, CPU only. Fixture-gated tests skip on hosts without the named locations; the skips are recorded as evidence, and the floor counts only executed tests (passed plus failed minus fixture-skip lines; ignored and filtered-out excluded) so a collection regression cannot pass silently.
surfaces.baseline_note: The allowed failure is pre-existing on main at ec0296ed9 (internal plan labels in docs/plans/q36-multigpu-pcie-ring.md, engine/src/capability/bundle.rs, engine/src/family/qwen36/cuda/card_block_device_tests.rs); it stays listed until those labels are reworded, and this entry fails the moment the test starts passing again. The floor counts only executed tests (passed plus failed minus fixture-skip lines): verified 2988 executed on a fixture-equipped host and 2975 on a fixture-less host at ec0296ed9; 2950 sits just below the fixture-less count. Under --nocapture, libtest writes the 'test NAME ... ' prefix without a newline, so prints from the test body can land on that line (glued status) or push the status onto a later bare line; the parser completes those torn shapes while keeping the counted==summary invariant (any miscount still fails). The >60-second libtest notices are noise lines and do not affect the count.
